translation: In summerheat disease, when the head is distended as if covered, it is all because heat prevails and blazes upward. Use Baihu and Zhuye; if there is wine-dampness and food stagnation, add acrid-warm to free the interior.

In summer, when one receives heat and becomes clouded and comatose as if frightened, this is summerheat syncope (shujue), caused by hot qi blocking and closing the orifices. The pathogen enters the collaterals, so the method is the same as for collateral stroke. The aromatic orifice-opening Niuhuang Wan and Zhibao Dan are effective.
After the spirit revives, use cooling blood-aspect medicines, such as Lianqiaoxin, Zhuyexin, Yuanshen, Xishengdi, Xianshengdi, and Erdong.
